title: Competing interests of guideline development group members have been recorded and addressed.

chain_of_thought.step1_locate: Competing Interests section under 'GUIDELINE DEVELOPMENT AND REVIEW PROCESS'
step2_evidence: At the start of the CPG development process and at other key points throughout, all members were required to submit disclosure statements for potential conflicts of interest in the previous 24 months. Verbal affirmations of no conflicts were used during meetings throughout the development process.
chain_of_thought.step3_reasoning: The guideline specifies the methodology for collection (required disclosure statements), reports the absence of conflicts (verbal affirmations of no conflicts), and implicitly describes no influence on the process (no conflicts identified). This meets all criteria for score 7 (collection method + report + description of NO influence). Types of interests were not explicitly listed, but the scoring principles do not require this element for the 7-point score. The guideline explicitly addresses all required elements for score 7.
